headline: AI Stocks Halt Brutal Sell-Off After $5.7 Trillion Global Infrastructure Rout
summary: Artificial intelligence shares bounced back Friday, pausing a steep multi-day sell-off that erased $5.7 trillion in value as investors re-evaluated heavy infrastructure spending and regulatory outlooks.
why: Heavy tech valuations driven by AI capex dominate major global indices, making sector-wide pullbacks central to overall equity market risk.

impacts.name: Global Artificial Intelligence and Semiconductor Sector
impacts.why: AI tech shares halted their severe sell-off and staged a Friday rebound.
